prompt:
Grace pulled me into a quick call about an hour ago and asked me to scrub my pipeline before the ops review on Friday. She wants to know which of my files are still being actively worked and which ones have gone cold. I told her I'd have a full picture by end of day, but as soon as I started pulling things up I realized I've got a bigger problem than I expected. Some of my loans are still showing loan officers who I'm pretty sure left the company months ago, and I've got files sitting in processing and underwriting where I can't tell whether anyone on the origination side has talked to the borrower recently. On top of that, I know I have documents that are still marked as needed but haven't come in.

I need you to go through every active loan in my pipeline and build me a status picture. For each file, check who the assigned loan officer is and whether that person is still with the company, because if they're gone then nobody is managing the borrower relationship and that loan needs reassignment. Check the document checklist and flag anything still in a required or requested state. Then search email and Slack to figure out which files have had no communication with the borrower or the assigned LO in the past three weeks, because those are the ones Grace will want to focus on. For the loans that have any of those problems, a departed LO, missing documents, or no recent communication, also pull the borrower's fee history and compare it against what's been billed to our vendors for appraisals and credit reports on that same file, because if a file fell through the cracks on the origination side the fee side might have gaps too.

Email Grace with a summary organized by urgency: which files are still moving, which need LO reassignment, and which have document or fee gaps. For every loan where the assigned LO is no longer active, send Elena an email asking her to help coordinate reassignment with Grace. Post in the processing channel that I'm running a pipeline scrub ahead of Friday's review. And log an activity note on every loan where the LO has left, a document is missing, or a fee discrepancy was found, so there's a record of what was flagged today.

criteria.cb_justification: The prompt opens with Grace wanting to know which files are still being actively worked and which have gone cold, and dedicates a full instruction to searching email and Slack for files with no borrower or assigned-LO communication in the past three weeks. Verified against the universe: of Darnell's 32 in-process loans, only LN-2025-00229 (a compliance breach notice from Denise Holloway on 4/14, not origination activity) and LN-2026-00197 (a boundary Slack message on 4/7) show any activity in the 3-week window; the remaining loans have no borrower/LO origination communication since late March, so the correct finding is that essentially the whole pipeline has gone cold. This is a distinct reported finding from the reassignment, document, and fee rubrics.
